import hashlib,json,os,resource,socket,sys,time
from collections import Counter
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import torch
import scoring.exact
import scoring.torch_backend
from scoring.cache import _load_case
from scoring.exact import canonical_dense_reference,validate_dense_reference

path=Path("/input.npz")
expected="9e112fd43465254809c603983e7f244b3f2fbadcadf0e1fb7326cfda02fb096e"
started=time.monotonic()
with path.open("rb") as stream:
    actual=hashlib.file_digest(stream,"sha256").hexdigest()
assert actual==expected
sha_seconds=time.monotonic()-started
assert torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.cuda.device_count()==1
assert "H200" in torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)
torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
hashes=[hashlib.sha256(),hashlib.sha256(),hashlib.sha256()]
strata=Counter()
routes=set()
negative=[]
case_hashes=[]
compute_seconds=[0.0,0.0]
validation_seconds=0.0
seen=set()
with np.load(path,allow_pickle=False) as archive:
    metadata=json.loads(archive["metadata"].tobytes())
    assert len(metadata["cases"])==384
    for index,row in enumerate(metadata["cases"]):
        case=_load_case(archive,index,row)
        strata[case.stratum]+=1
        routes.add(case.route)
        key=json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()
        hashes[0].update(key)
        hashes[0].update(case.dense.tobytes())
        produced=[]
        for repeat in range(2):
            tick=time.monotonic()
            dense=canonical_dense_reference(case.q,case.k,case.v,case.query_valid_counts,case.key_valid_counts,device="cuda:0")
            compute_seconds[repeat]+=time.monotonic()-tick
            assert dense.tobytes()==case.dense.tobytes(), (index,repeat)
            hashes[repeat+1].update(key)
            hashes[repeat+1].update(dense.tobytes())
            produced.append(hashlib.sha256(dense.tobytes()).hexdigest())
        assert produced[0]==produced[1]
        tick=time.monotonic()
        assert validate_dense_reference(case,device="cuda:0")==(0.0,0.0,0.0)
        validation_seconds+=time.monotonic()-tick
        case_hashes.append({"case_index":index,"stratum":case.stratum,"route":case.route,"step_index":case.step_index,"dense_sha256":produced[0]})
        if case.stratum not in seen:
            seen.add(case.stratum)
            bit=case.dense.copy()
            bit.view(np.uint16).flat[0]^=np.uint16(1)
            zero=canonical_dense_reference(case.q,case.k,np.zeros_like(case.v),case.query_valid_counts,case.key_valid_counts,device="cuda:0")
            zero_case=replace(case,v=np.zeros_like(case.v),dense=zero)
            assert validate_dense_reference(zero_case,device="cuda:0")==(0.0,0.0,0.0)
            sign=zero.copy()
            sign.view(np.uint16).flat[0]^=np.uint16(0x8000)
            assert np.array_equal(sign,zero) and sign.tobytes()!=zero.tobytes()
            for kind,bad in [("real_dense_lsb",replace(case,dense=bit)),("real_dense_plus_100",replace(case,dense=case.dense+np.float16(100))),("zero_v_control_signed_zero_bit",replace(zero_case,dense=sign))]:
                try:
                    validate_dense_reference(bad,device="cuda:0")
                except ValueError as exc:
                    assert "diverges from its Q/K/V" in str(exc)
                    negative.append({"stratum":case.stratum,"mutation":kind,"rejected":True,"error":str(exc)})
                else:
                    raise AssertionError((case.stratum,kind,"accepted"))
        del case,dense
        if (index+1)%96==0:
            print(json.dumps({"event":"progress","cases_validated":index+1}),file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
assert len(strata)==4 and set(strata.values())=={96} and len(routes)==8
assert len(negative)==12
assert len(set(value.hexdigest() for value in hashes))==1
assert not any(name=="miowtion" or name.startswith("miowtion.") for name in sys.modules)
source={}
for module in (scoring.exact,scoring.torch_backend):
    p=Path(module.__file__)
    source[module.__name__]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
print(json.dumps({"format":"veda-canonical-dense-numeric-evidence-v1","scope":"numeric repeat/restart/cross-GPU validation on historical canonical cache; not current READY or formal release acceptance","code_commit":os.environ["VEDA_PROBE_COMMIT"],"physical_gpu":int(os.environ["VEDA_PHYSICAL_GPU"]),"run":os.environ["VEDA_PROBE_RUN"],"container_hostname":socket.gethostname(),"gpu_uuid":str(torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).uuid),"gpu":torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),"torch":torch.__version__,"cuda":torch.version.cuda,"python":sys.executable,"cache_sha256":actual,"cache_bytes":path.stat().st_size,"geometry_case_counts":dict(strata),"route_count":len(routes),"case_count":384,"canonical_passes":2,"stored_dense_stream_sha256":hashes[0].hexdigest(),"regenerated_dense_stream_sha256":[value.hexdigest() for value in hashes[1:]],"max_abs":0.0,"mean_abs":0.0,"rse":0.0,"bitwise_equal":True,"negative_controls":negative,"dense_case_hashes":case_hashes,"canonical_compute_seconds":compute_seconds,"reference_validation_seconds":validation_seconds,"input_sha_seconds":sha_seconds,"elapsed_seconds":time.monotonic()-started,"peak_cuda_bytes":torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),"peak_host_rss_kib":resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,"source_sha256":source},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
scope: Numerical repeat, fresh-process and cross-GPU verification only; historical canonical cache is not accepted as a current READY artifact.
